pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_gruss: Coach, I will come straight to you, it is about my position.
Coach, have you got a moment for a serious word about my position?
pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_lage: On my position two of us have been fighting for one place for weeks, and I feel the scales are not balanced fairly.
There are two of us who want the same position, and I cannot see by what standards you choose between us.
pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_lage.hit: For weeks I have been sitting out while the other one plays my position, and I will not put up with it any longer!
The other one on my position is being favoured, anyone can see it, and I am sick of playing second fiddle!
pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_lage.loy: I have never complained and always put myself at the service of the team, but I feel passed over on my position.
I do not begrudge the other one his games on my position, but being treated like a mere reserve hurts.
pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_lage.ehr: I want to play my position and I am convinced I am better than the other one, but I never get a real chance to prove it.
In every session I go flat out to push the other one off my position, and I wonder whether anyone notices.
pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_lage.wec: If I stay behind the other one on my position for good, I have to ask myself whether I would be needed somewhere else.
On my position I stand in the other one's shadow for ever, and I am not sure I want to stay here for that.
pool.b.rivalen_gleiche_position_lage.sen: It gnaws at me that the other one plays my position and I do not know what I am doing wrong.
I watch the other one start on my position every week and wonder whether you still believe in me at all.
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_gruss: Boss, quick one between training and the shower: it is about penalties.
Coach, I have to raise something that has lain around too long, namely the spot kick.
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_lage: On the last penalties two team-mates nearly fought over the ball, and in front of the referee it did not look good.
We have no fixed order for penalties, and every time two lads argue on the pitch about who takes it.
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_lage.hitzig: Two of my lads nearly came to blows over a penalty, and I am fed up that nobody sorts it out!
On the pitch two of them shout at each other over who shoots, and as captain I stand in between and do not know what to do!
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_lage.loyal: I do not want to expose anyone, but two of them quarrel over penalties, and that hurts all of us.
It is awkward to come to you with this, yet there is unrest over spot kicks that we cannot afford.
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_lage.ehrgeizig: A penalty can decide a game, and I want the best to take it and not the loudest.
When we play for points there can be no quarrel over penalties, only the most reliable taker.
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_lage.wechselfreud: I have even wondered whether I still want to be a taker if the quarrel over it does not stop.
The row over penalties annoys me so much I can hardly imagine carrying on like this much longer.
pool.b.elfmeter_streit_lage.sensibel: It weighs on me how the two go at each other over a penalty, I hardly dare step in any more.
I can see the taker is suffering under the pressure, and it hurts me how the quarrel occupies him.
pool.b.kabine_clique_gruss: Coach, can I speak to you in private? It is about the mood in the dressing room.
Coach, I have to report something I no longer want to watch like this.
pool.b.kabine_clique_lage: Camps have formed in the dressing room, the old hands sit together, so do the young ones, and hardly anyone talks across the groups any more.
There are fixed little groups in the squad by now: compatriots stick together and the others are left out.
pool.b.kabine_clique_lage.hitzig: The dressing room has fallen into camps and jibes fly back and forth until I have had enough!
The old against the young, and both sides snipe at each other, I can hardly stand it any more!
pool.b.kabine_clique_lage.loyal: I love this team, and it pains me to see it split into camps.
For the club's sake I say it openly: groups are forming in the dressing room that hardly look at one another any more.
pool.b.kabine_clique_lage.ehrgeizig: A team that falls into camps wins nothing, and I want us to pull together again.
If we want to compete at the top we need a dressing room without fronts, and we are far from that.
pool.b.kabine_clique_lage.wechselfreudig: If the dressing room stays this divided some will think about whether they still belong here.
The camps make it hard for some, and I notice individuals are already talking about a move.
pool.b.kabine_clique_lage.sensibel: It touches me how cold it has become between the groups, and I notice individuals suffering from it.
I see how some in the dressing room feel excluded because they have no place in either camp.
pool.b.kabine_streich_gruss: Coach, team question: we have an idea for dressing-room life.
Hey coach, we have thought of something and wanted to ask you first.
pool.b.kabine_streich_lage: We want to welcome our new man to the squad with the usual ritual, a bit of fun is a must.
Someone has a birthday and the lads would like to play a little prank on him, nothing nasty of course.
pool.b.kabine_streich_lage.hitzig: We won and want to celebrate, and this time it is the new boy's turn whether he likes it or not!
A ritual is part of it, and if nobody joins in I will do it alone!
pool.b.kabine_streich_lage.loyal: The team sticks together and a custom like this strengthens that if it is done right.
Everyone in the dressing room likes the new man, and that is precisely why we want to play a prank he will remember fondly.
pool.b.kabine_streich_lage.ehrgeizig: Things have been going really well since the wins, and a ritual would cement team spirit for the next games.
A prank like this welds us together, and we can carry the momentum from the good results.
pool.b.kabine_streich_lage.wechselfreudi: The new man will soon be gone if he does not feel accepted, so we need an initiation.
Some come and go so fast that a ritual is the best chance of tying him in.
pool.b.kabine_streich_lage.sensibel: I want the new man to feel welcome, but I am unsure whether a prank would be too much for him.
We mean well with the new man, but I worry it could embarrass him.
